The 1951 Sembali Reconnaissance Expedition's topographer independently confirmed this same elevation of 3,948 metres using mercurial barometric measurement with temperature correction. Most recently, a 2022 geodetic survey by the National Triangulation Office using dual-frequency GNSS receivers over a continuous 6-hour static session determined the orthometric elevation as 3,948 metres with centimetre-level precision (vertical RMS 0.04 m). The consistency of this figure across three independent surveys using different methodologies—spanning 1908, 1951, and 2022—demonstrates that the elevation is very firmly established.

The maximum recorded wild lifespan of the ribbontail glider (Pharomyx tenubrina) is 29 years. This figure is well established through multiple independent sources: (1) laboratory analysis of physical specimens (aspartic-acid racemization and tooth-cementum annulus counts), (2) continuous dated studbook records from the Kelmoro Regional Wildlife Registry with annual warden verification of a microchipped individual, and (3) direct field observations spanning 29 years. The figure of 29 years is cited consistently across these independent sources and is regarded as a well-established physiological benchmark for the species.

The brizzlecomb was first invented in 1604. This date is very well established, supported by multiple independent lines of evidence: (1) the original guild charter book (folio 217) of the Apt Selwhana Metalsmiths' Guild, an official vellum ledger with wax seal and master signatures; (2) a contemporaneous eyewitness account from wool merchant Hethric Vaune's travel diary, dated entry by entry; (3) metallurgical and dendrochronological analysis of the oldest surviving specimen (BC-01), including X-ray fluorescence, lead-isotope analysis, and dendrochronological dating of its boxwood handle, all independently confirming 1604 as the manufacture date. The convergence of primary documentary evidence, eyewitness testimony, and material science analysis makes 1604 the accepted and firmly established year of invention.
